text:
marie: Quick Q  my friend is stopping by around 12:45 with a small dog and a potted fern. Is it OK to bring both? Also might be a package for me today. Can you hold it if it arrives? :plant::dog:
front-desk: Yep, guests welcome. Policy reminder: dogs in lounge area only, on leash. We'll print a guest badge, and we can hold packages in locker B2. Which name for the badge?
marie: Please make the badge for 'Elliot Park'. If the package arrives for me (Marie Chen) could you add a "Fragile" note? It's a ceramic planter.
reception-bot: Guest badge queued for "Elliot Park" at 12:40. Badge ID: G-2028.
tony: If you want a quieter spot, the reading nook on level 2 is free after 1pm. I can move the armchair over in 5.
alia: Heads up: if the plant has soil, pls don't leave it on the mail shelf (bugs). @front-desk can you also keep an eye on any damp soil on the mat?
front-desk: Will do. Also package arrived early  labeled "fragile ceramics" for Marie Chen. We noted a faint coffee scent on the box. Storing in locker B2, sticky note "Fragile - keep upright" attached. Ringing x1023 when guest checks in.
ben: :dog2: can i pet the dog when i get back? kidding. enjoy the fern!
marie: haha save me a pet later :grin: thanks all
front-desk: Guest checked in at 12:46. Badge handed to Elliot. Mat placed by east window, extension cord available. Package signed and in B2.
marie: Amazing, thank you! We'll keep the dog on the mat and away from chairs. See you soon.
tony: Armchair moved and secured, plant-friendly spot reserved by east window.
front-desk: All set  closing the loop.
